subject: Tier-swap prepay structure question
messages:
From: Jared Liu <jared.liu@solaramed.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Flexible prepay options for a 2-year commitment

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the cost transparency. We have two procurement questions as we craft an exec recommendation:

1) Solara wants a 2-year committed arrangement but we anticipate shifting workload between product lines year-to-year. Is there a way to allow us to swap committed capacity across SKUs/teams mid-term without losing the prepay discount?

2) If year 1 utilization undershoots the committed amount, can unused credits be carried into year 2, or are there buyback/credit terms?

I attached our FY28 usage projection and a high-level MA outline.

Can you share what flexibility you’ve granted other customers on tier swaps and how that impacts discounting? We need clear contract language for procurement.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Liu
Head of Platform Engineering, Solara Health
Attachments: Solara_MA_plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@solaramed.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flexible prepay options for a 2-year commitment

Hi Jared — great to hear the demo resonated. Quick answers up front and then a couple of options:

Short answers:
- Tier swaps: Yes, we can support a limited number of inter-SKU swaps mid-term but there are guardrails (see options below).
- Carry-forward credits: We can allow a one-time carry-forward of up to 20% of year-1 committed spend into year 2 for a 2-year agreement (with policy conditions).

Options we typically propose (we can make this contractual):
A) Standard 2-year prepay (highest discount)
  - 18% discount off list for annual prepay
  - No swaps allowed mid-year; reallocation only at annual renewal
  - Unused credits: refunded at cost or applied as one-time adjustment at renewal (no carry)

B) Swap-friendly 2-year prepay (mid-range discount)
  - 12–15% discount depending on total committed $
  - Allow up to 1 swap per 12-month period between SKU allocations (requires 30 days notice)
  - One-time carry-forward up to 20% of unused year-1 credits into year 2
  - Swaps limited to equal-or-lower-cost SKUs unless pre-approved by us
C) Annualized prepay w/ escrow (more flexible, lower discount)
  - 8% discount with quarterly reconciliation
  - Unlimited internal reallocation within agreed product family
  - Unused credits rolled forward within the contract year only

If you’re comfortable, I’ll loop in Ben from Sales and Rishi from Finance to get approval for B) with a 15% discount and the 20% carry-forward. I attached a draft quote.

Next steps: Which option would you like priced, and do you want the swap to be team-to-team or SKU-to-SKU?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Solara Health — ask to approve swap-friendly 2yr prepay (thread for approval)

Ben / Rishi — Jared Liu at Solara asked about a 2-year prepay but needs the ability to move committed dollars between product teams (they call this a "tier swap"). They’d like us to:

- Approve a Swap-friendly 2-year prepay (option B in my note to Jared) with:
  * 15% discount
  * 1 swap allowed per 12-month period (30 days notice)
  * One-time carry-forward up to 20% of unused year-1 credits into year 2
- Condition: swaps to be allowed only between SKUs within the same product family unless we sign off otherwise.
- They will accept a contractual clause limiting swaps and requiring a short notice window.

Risk / finance note: allowing carry-forward reduces near-term cash conversion and may impact revenue recognition. Rishi — can you confirm whether 20% carry-forward is acceptable from a billing/revenue ops perspective? If not, what limit would you recommend?

Ben — if approved, can you sign off on the 15% discount so I can send a formal quote and SOW request to Legal?

Thanks,
Naomi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solara Health — ask to approve swap-friendly 2yr prepay (thread for approval)

Naomi — I support moving forward with Option B at 15% subject to Rishi/Marissa's ok on revenue ops constraints. A few running notes: 

- 15% is near our standard mid-tier and keeps the deal ACV-friendly.
- Limit swaps technically to 1 per 12 months and require the swap request to include a target allocation and expected run-rate; ops must approve any swap that increases peak concurrency by >15%.
- For carry-forward, prefer 15% cap but can stretch to 20% for strategic logos. Jared looks strategic, but let’s let finance decide.

If Rishi/Marissa are comfortable with a 20% carry-forward for Solara, I’m happy to approve the 15% and push the quote + SOW.

—Ben
Enterprise Sales Director
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solara Health — ask to approve swap-friendly 2yr prepay (thread for approval)

Thanks for the context. Finance & RevOps review:

- Carry-forward: 20% is borderline but acceptable if constrained by a one-time use and limited to Year 2 only. We need a clear contract clause that any carried credits are applied before any pro-rata refunds and will be reconciled at renewal.
- Revenue recognition: we will recognize per ASC rules for prepaids; the carry-forward creates deferred revenue complexity but it’s manageable.
- Billing ops: require a single line-item "Carry-forward credit" for year-2 invoice adjustments so AR can trace it.

Marissa — please provide final approval on the discount and confirm whether we can operationalize the single carry-forward cap in our billing system. If yes, I’m ok with 15% discount and the other conditions.

Rishi
Senior Finance Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jared Liu <jared.liu@solaramed.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solara Health — ask to approve swap-friendly 2yr prepay (thread for approval)

Naomi / team / Jared — final from RevOps and legal guardrails: approved with conditions. Please see summary and next steps below.

Approved commercial terms:
- 2-year Swap-friendly prepay at 15% discount (annual prepay).
- Allow 1 swap per 12-month period with 30 days notice; swaps limited to SKUs within product families unless mutually agreed in writing.
- One-time carry-forward up to 20% of unused year-1 committed spend into year 2 only. Carry-forward cannot be further rolled into subsequent terms.
- Carry-forward to be captured as a single invoice line-item in year-2 reconciliation.

Contract & Ops next steps:
1) Naomi: confirm with Jared whether they want the swap scoped as team-to-team or SKU-to-SKU.
2) Naomi / Ben: Legal to prepare SOW amendment with the swap clause and carry-forward language; include the single-line invoice requirement.
3) Rishi / Marissa: RevOps will configure the billing rule once Legal approves language.

Jared — I’ll mark this as approved from our side. Naomi — please send the formal quote and the SOW request and include the attachments referenced earlier.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Solara Health 2yr Swap-friendly prepay — terms and next steps

Hi Jared — thanks for your patience. Internal approvals are in and we can offer the Swap-friendly 2-year prepay under these confirmed terms: 

- 15% discount on annual prepay for the committed amount.
- One swap allowed per 12-month period (30 days notice), limited to SKUs within the same product family unless otherwise agreed in writing.
- One-time carry-forward up to 20% of unused year-1 committed spend into year 2 only (cannot be carried further).
- Carry-forward will appear as a single invoice line-item in year 2 reconciliation.

If that matches what you need, I’ll: 
- Send a formal quote and updated SOW to Legal for the swap clause.
- Route the quote via DocuSign once Legal signs off.

Please reply with your preference: team-to-team swaps or SKU-to-SKU swaps as the default.

Best,
